TAKE HIM OUT QUICKLY!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 40 (Formerly, [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Fallen King''' is the final boss of [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode and [[The Takeover Event]]. While it walks quite slowly, it has a high amount of health and multiple abilities, that allow it to summon enemies, stun towers or to make itself stronger. It is also immune to being stunned by towers like the [[Electroshocker]] and only slowed down, frozen by freezing towers like the [[Freezer]], slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]], knocked back by towers like the [[Brawler]], confused by the [[Jester]], damaged by the [[Nuke]]'s fallout damage, slowed down by the [[DJ Booth]] or have its defense reduced. It has five abilities: #First is ''Undead Charge'', which makes it raise its sword forward, summoning five [[Necrotic Skeleton]]s with a 0.25 second delay between each one. #The second ability, ''Summon'', is another summoning ability, though this one makes the '''Fallen King''' raise its sword in the air, which summons forty enemies, which can be the [[Fallen Hero]], [[Fallen Giant]], [[Corrupted Fallen]], [[Possessed Armor]] and [[Fallen Necromancer]]. Only can happen once. #The third ability, ''Sword Swing'', makes it slash its sword multiple times, stunning towers for 6 seconds and damaging units by 100 each swing. #The fourth ability is ''Fallen Comet'', where it impales its sword into the ground, causing multiple shards to fall down from the sky, stunning towers for 5 seconds and dealing 50 damage to any unit hit. It also has a fifth ability, ''Bone Armor'', which is a passive ability that happens when the '''Fallen King''' loses health, making it gain [[Defense]] until it reaches a [[Defense]] of 60% or higher. It uses the following equation to decide if it should increase its [[Defense]]:
\frac{\text{Default Health} - \text{Current Health}}{\text{Default Health}}\times 100
Default health initially is the starting health value of the '''Fallen King''', which for example in solo matches is 250,000 while current health is just how much health it currently has. Once the result of the equation is equal or higher to 20, and as long as its current [[Defense]] is not the same or higher as its max [[Defense]], its [[Defense]] will increase by 15% and the default health value will change into whatever its health was at the moment of the [[Defense]] getting increased. For example, if it increases its [[Defense]] while its current health is 160,000, default health will change to that number, and then its [[Defense]] will be increased by 15%. Due to this, the required damage for it to increase starts out at 20% of its max health and gets lower with each requirement. Therefore, it will increase its [[Defense]] after losing at least 20% of its health, then 36%, 51.2% and 59.4%, varied based on the health the '''Fallen King''' had during each increase. Because of how its ''Bone Armor'' mechanic works, in [[Challenge Maps]] where the '''Fallen King''' has lower health, it will instantly gain [[Defense]] due to its default health being 250,000 and its current health being for example 75,000. This would make a number larger than 20 in the equation, making it have [[Defense]] instantly. In the case of it having its health increased, this is entirely dependent on the source. For example, the [[Bloated]] attribute will boost its default health value, meaning it will gain 15% more [[Defense]] at 400,000 health, but the [[Double Health]] modifier will not boost it, meaning it will gain a [[Defense]] boost at the same health as without it, that being 200,000 health. ==Logbook Description== "''The Fallen King once ruled his kingdom with wisdom and compassion. When magic began to fade, he searched everywhere for salvation, but failed. When he returned, it was too late. As a last resort, the Queen used her life to cast an ancient spell, believing it would bring magic back to their kingdom. Instead, it released a curse that consumed everything. Now, he rules an empty kingdom with an insatiable army that only hungers for battle. They raid endlessly, fighting because war is the only outlet they have left. Deep within, despite him not recognizing it, the King searches for someone strong enough to end his torment and finally grant him the peace he failed to give his people.''" ==Appearance== The '''Fallen King''' wears a silver and dark grey armor, with cyan spikes on its shoulders as well as cyan details on its arms, torso and legs. A cyan diamond can be found in its lower torso, and it wears silver boots with small diamonds in their front. The '''Fallen King''' also wears a helmet that shows its cyan glowing eyes and a cyan crown with crystals in it. Lastly, it carries a sharp cyan sword as well as a shield, with a diamond in the middle and cyan spikes on the sides. When defeated, the '''Fallen King''' will throw its sword on the ground and disappear in a beam of light. That animation is different upon triggering the [[Hidden Wave]], where it will later come back with some differences as the [[Awakened Fallen King]]. ==Strategy== *As with most major bosses, high DPS towers such as the [[Minigunner]], [[Pursuit]], [[Ranger]], [[Turret]] and [[Accelerator]] are recommended to deal with the '''Fallen King'''. **The [[Commander]], [[Mercenary Base]] and [[DJ Booth]] can also be used to boost these towers. **They should also be able to take care of the '''Fallen King's''' summons pretty easily. **The [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] are immune to stuns from the '''Fallen King's''' abilities, making them very useful against it. *As the '''Fallen King''' has the [[Boss]] and [[Stun Immunity]] attribute, it cannot be shocked, stunned or frozen by most towers. **The [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Sledger]] can only chill the '''Fallen King''' instead of freezing it. **The [[Electroshocker]], [[Tesla]] and [[Warden]] also cannot stun it, and have a weaker slowing effect on it. ***However, these towers can be useful against the enemies that appear before the '''Fallen King'''. **The [[Toxic Gunner]] cannot slow this enemy down as it is immune to its slowing effect. It can, however, be useful against the enemies that appear before it. **The [[Jester]] cannot confuse the '''Fallen King''', but it can slow it down with its ice bombs. *Make sure to sell any [[Farm]]s to maximize the number of towers attacking the '''Fallen King'''. They do not produce any income anymore, still count towards your tower limit, and can be replaced by a more useful tower. **The [[Cowboy]] and [[Golden Cowboy]] can still produce income, so you can keep them if you need more cash for your towers. However, this is generally not necessary, as you will get a lot of cash from damaging enemies and the '''Fallen King''' itself. *If you want to activate the [[Hidden Wave]], it will be helpful to bring the [[Gatling Gun]], as you can manually aim at the '''Fallen King''' to quickly kill it instead of having to set your towers to ''Strongest'' targeting. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Summon Abilities |- |[[File:FallenKingSummon1.ogg]] |When the '''Fallen King''' performs ''Undead Charge'' ability |- |[[File:FallenKingSummon2.ogg]] |When the '''Fallen King''' performs ''Summon'' ability |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Stun Abilities |- |[[File:FallenKingSwordAttack1.ogg]] |When the '''Fallen King''' performs ''Sword Swing'' ability |- |[[File:AwakenedFallenKingAbominableBarrage.ogg]] |When the '''Fallen King ''' performs ''Fallen Comet'' ability |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Death |- |[[File:FallenKingDeath.ogg]] |When the '''Fallen King''' dies |- |[[File:FallenKingDeathTransform.ogg]] |When the '''Fallen King''' dies before transforming into the [[Awakened Fallen King]] |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} FallenKingWalk.gif|Walking animation (2 August 2024 – Present) FallenKingSummon.gif|''Undead Charge'' animation (2 August 2024 – Present) FallenKingSummonAgain.gif|''Summon'' animation (2 August 2024 – Present) FallenKingSpin.gif|''Sword Swing'' animation (2 August 2024 – Present) FallenKingComet.gif|''Fallen Comet'' animation (2 August 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} FallenFoesThumbnail.png|'''Fallen King''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} FallenFoesUpdateIcon.png|'''Fallen King''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Gatling Gun Tower - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Fallen King''' on a promotional video.
